description: Reach a consensus on the APPROACH before committing a fleet to build it. Spawn several biased, independent solvers that each propose a plan for the same question, then an independent judge that converges them into one concrete plan (or narrows the question and re-runs). Use when the approach is contested - multiple valid designs, ambiguous scope, or a costly wrong turn - not for obvious work. The engine runs the agents; this playbook is the judgment. Hand the converged plan to marshal-orchestrate to build it.
